items.title: Boston Scientific (BSX) Stock Looks Cheap After a 55% Slump
items.summary: Boston Scientific stock has had a steep year, with a sharp share price decline set against valuation checks that point to a potentially cheap entry point based on intrinsic value and market multiples. The stock now screens as undervalued on both a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view and on broader valuation metrics, which raises questions about how much of the recent operational setbacks the market has already priced in.
